# MP-365

> MP-365 (Modern Partners 365) is a Microsoft Solutions Partner that helps mid-size and enterprise companies get more out of Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365 and Copilot.

## Services

- [All services](https://mp-365.com/services/)
- [Dynamics 365 CRM Consultation](https://mp-365.com/services/dynamics-365-crm/)

## Not offered

- ERP implementation (Business Central, Finance and Operations, Supply Chain, Field Service)
- Azure infrastructure
- cybersecurity and identity management
- Microsoft licence resale or CSP
- managed services or help desk
- standalone AI consulting
- custom software development
- Google Workspace migration
- Dynamics 365 Contact Center
- formal process improvement practice
